description: "After five failed attempts to secure the necessary appropriation, sustained opposition from the surrounding community, unresolved questions about the site, and continued legislative debate about Arkansas’s actual correctional capacity needs, I believe we have reached the point where the state should move on from this property."

title: Statement on Why Arkansas Should Sell the Franklin County Prison Property
